game_title: Roll Call Enumerate – Spirit Stream Rush
game_concept: A speed quiz set in Mystic Forest – Spirit Stream, a stream of spirits: the druid must handle thorn goblins while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Roll Call Enumerate: Use enumerate to call out each position and name in a roll call.
theme: Mystic Forest – Spirit Stream: a stream of spirits
core_gameplay_loop: In Spirit Stream, repeat each round: Use enumerate to call out each position and name in a roll call. Each round, a new acorns challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the roll_call value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 550 points of acorns by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 550, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 9 (extended tier): Roll Call Enumerate
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Roll Call Enumerate' (Week 5 slot 9), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Spirit Stream'. tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how roll_call changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against thorn goblins in Spirit Stream.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 550 within 43 seconds.
